title: Government Policy, Strategic Consumer Behavior, and Spillovers to Retailers: The Case of Demonetization in India
authors: Yewon Kim; Pradeep K. Chintagunta; Bhuvanesh Pareek
eligible_reason: India demonetization: strategic purchases and returns at a retail chain around a single common shock date (Nov 8, 2016), estimated by bunching/high-order time polynomials. Not staggered.
design_notes: StrategicPurchaseReturn_bunching_MSsubmission.R: lm(purchase_noac ~ post_days + polynomials + holidays ...) by store and tender type, counterfactual bunching estimates; Demonetization indicator switches on for all units on the same date.
data_files_note: readme: DF.RData contains 60% of transactions from one single store in the chain (code loops over several stores).
data_provenance_note: Single-store 60% extract with no stated random sampling rule.
screener_notes: No article text or published PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); screened from README, regression inventory, main-results code and OpenAlex abstract. Out of scope.
